title: Comparison of Two Pain and Bleeding Control Methods in Back Surgery: A Study on Periarticular Vasoconstrictor Infiltration (PIV) vs. Erector Spinae Plane Block (ESP) in Lumbar Fusion Surgery.
official: EFFICACY OF VASOCONSTRICTOR PERIARTICULAR INFILTRATION (PIV) VERSUS ERECTOR SPINAE PLANE BLOCK (ESP) IN REDUCING BLEEDING AND POSTOPERATIVE PAIN CONTROL IN LUMBAR ARTHRODESIS SURGERY. RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL.
summary: Main objective: To compare the effectiveness of PIV block versus ESP block in reducing bleeding and improving postoperative pain control in lumbar fusion surgery, a procedure associated with significant blood loss and severe postoperative pain.

interventions.name: Ropivacaína Altan 2 mg/ml solución inyectable EFG
Adrenalina B. Braun 1 mg/ml Solución Inyectable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men and women scheduled for lumbar fusion surgery (maximum of 3 instrumented levels).
2. Age >18 years.
3. Signed informed consent form
Exclusion criteria:
1. Allergy to local anesthetics.
2. Revision lumbar spine surgery.
3. Patients with a local infection.
4. Patients with connective tissue diseases or vasculitis.
5. Chronic pain treated with opioids (Oral Morphine Equivalent Dose > 50 mg/day).
